direction.name: OFFLINE MOCK: Long Meadow Pavilions
direction.concept: A glass living pavilion between two long bedroom wings, linked by an entry spine; flat planes and deep shade toward the east garden.
hierarchy: Glass living pavilion as the focal volume
direction.roofLanguage: Flat stone-capped roof planes with deep overhangs over glass.
direction.entrance: A recessed west entrance into a gallery-like foyer.
direction.outdoorLiving: A covered loggia off the pavilion, a lap pool and a separate sun terrace.
direction.landscape: Mixed palms and canopy trees, layered beds and open lawns.
